integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the ellipsoid Funk-ball integral, changes variables by t=tanh(s), uses the published exact Hanner volume, and reduces the comparison to strict monotonicity of sinh(x)/x. A standalone standard-library checker verifies both integral coordinates, the normalized quotient, limiting normalization, and finite-radius samples; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves the two-radius Hanner comparison only for centered ellipsoids. It does not settle the conjecture for arbitrary centrally symmetric convex bodies. The monotonicity argument is elementary after combining the exact ellipsoid and Hanner volume formulas, so unindexed prior observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Ellipsoids satisfy the Funk Hanner ratio conjecture in every dimension
